notes.title: Sword King Update v0.1
notes.notes:
Features of the update:
- Weapons now have weight, and a slider has been added in the gameplay options menu to customize the amount of weight. Furthermore, the physics simulation settings for all weapons have been tweaked to allow them to have weight while still being responsive. 
- All weapons are now gripped tilted forward by default, and the angle is customizable globally from the gameplay options menu as well as individually from the inventory menu.
- It's now possible to grab enemies that have been hit more than seven times, and they can be thrown around. They will die shortly after.
- Fixed a bug that caused the controller and the weapon to stop working when grabbing a weapon with two hands.

notes.title: Controller bug fix coming in a few days
notes.notes: We are in the process of fixing  the bug that causes the controllers to lose tracking, and we will have an update in the coming days.
